protocol:
# Skill Studio — separate evaluation v2, preregistered before inference

Status: PREEXECUTION. This series never edits evaluation/ or evaluation-next/. Historical HONEST_NEGATIVE is retained.

## Question and fairness
Three arms: competent BASE_SYSTEM alone, the same base with reference_ai_assisted, and the same base with qwen_generated. Three families: supplied ACG report interpretation, discounted_total regression, synthetic release note. The common AUTHOR_BRIEF.json restates every procedural lesson of the existing references and uses the same three public development examples (skill_studio/tasks.py). Reference authoring time and tokens are unknown; this is not an unaided human comparison. No hypothesis that Qwen or skills win.

One Qwen author call per family, no retries, raw body retained without fence/YAML repair. The app supplies an identical YAML name/description wrapper for both candidates of each family. Skills-ref metadata, supported runtime, resource constraints and <=200 whitespace-delimited body words are deterministic package criteria. No incomplete generation (length finish), empty/repetitive body, outer fence/frontmatter, link or missing external resource. French/reusability/instruction semantics are independently reviewed. Invalid packages are retained and mark that arm's three uses as strict failures without calling the model for an unusable package (cost/latency N/A, not zero-latency success). Baseline package validity is N/A, satisfying the package gate by definition. Package validity alone says nothing about usefulness.

## Predeclared order amendment
The earlier prepared PLAN.md is preserved. To test the actual largest candidate context, the preparation order is explicitly amended BEFORE the first call: three single candidate generations, then six runtime probes. No quality-based choice between variants. Six probes: each of acg/regression/release, short original development context and long context padded with labelled inert synthetic text to 5968–6000 rendered UTF-8 bytes; both include the larger of that family's two frozen candidate packages. This tests a long byte context, not a claim to reach 6144 tokens. The extra conservative 6144-byte input guard supplements the measured 6144-token maximum. All six must finish without length truncation, declared degeneracy, missing metrics, crash, hash failure, timeout or RSS violation. Any failed probe stops preparation and forbids holdout execution in this series. No retry.

## Fixed model, resources and accounting
Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 Q4_K_M, SHA-256 3605803b982cb64aead44f6c1b2ae36e3acdb41d8e46c8a94c6533bc4c67e597. llama.cpp b10930 CPU binaries checked against skill_studio/runtime_manifest.json before each process. Dedicated scripts/evaluation_worker.py enforces temperature 0, seed 42, context 8192, max output 1024, six CPU threads, batch/ubatch 512. top_p .8, top_k 20 and min_p 0 are reported as inactive for greedy sampling. Same Qwen ChatML adapter, new process/context per call, no GPU. Input <=6144 tokens, plus the stricter rendered-byte guard; measured token overflow stops as infrastructure/protocol failure. Native sample accounting may count one EOS token beyond the 1024 generation cap and is retained honestly. One inference at a time, using the same advisory lock as the local app; lock wait counts against the call budget. Existing model and resources only; no downloads, paid API, training, private corpus or owner files.

Preparation global monotonic budget 18 minutes for at most 9 calls. Final global monotonic budget 54 minutes for at most 27 calls, 27648 configured output-token slots (native EOS accounting reported separately). Each job <=120 seconds including lock wait, native inference timeout 115 seconds. Native child RSS monitored every 50 ms, killed above 6 GiB, also checked against measured child ru_maxrss. RSS sampling is an observation/enforcement aid, not a kernel hard cap. API spend €0; electricity and reference author time unknown. Measure input/output tokens, native worker and whole-job wall time, peak native RSS per job, plus whole-stage time. Do not call this energy-free or costless.

## Freeze, holdout and stopping
PREEXECUTION.json hashes protocol, common brief, runner/worker, app prompt/verification dependencies, tests, runtime manifest and unchanged reference candidates before first inference. CANDIDATES_FROZEN.json seals all six candidates, PREEXECUTION, preparation result and the nine complete call receipts plus start latches after the six probes. Only then a fresh independent author gets common requirements, case schema and rubric, WITHOUT any candidate, output or historical case. It creates nine new cases, three per family, with reference reasoning. New cases must test substantive combinations/boundaries, not renumber old cases. HOLDOUT_FROZEN.json must seal HOLDOUT.json, CANDIDATES_FROZEN.json, CASE_SCHEMA.json and PROTOCOL.md before final inference. The runner verifies required manifest membership, safe unique IDs, types, three cases per family and bounded criteria before any final call. All rendered reserved-case/arm prompts must fit the fixed byte guard before the final latch. No prompt/package/runner edits or tuning after any final output. Each call verifies frozen hashes. Invocation latches and exclusive new output files forbid silent reruns/overwrites.

Latin order within each family: baseline/reference/qwen, reference/qwen/baseline, qwen/baseline/reference. The exact same case user message reaches every arm. Invalid package skips are declared failures. Truncation, repetitive output, wrong content or format count as arm failures and the series continues. Only integrity/infrastructure failures (hash, crash, timeout, absent/out-of-bound metrics or resource breach) stop final execution, preserving partial data and identifying incomplete triplets. The declared repetition detector is >=41 identical consecutive characters or a repeated 12-word sequence appearing at least four times; independent semantic review can identify additional task failure without changing this detector.

## Criteria fixed before outputs
Strict success = package gate satisfied AND all deterministic and independently reviewed instructions AND task success AND operational success. Report each axis separately. Case-specific exact fragments, maximum whitespace word count, ordered section titles and final sentence must be visible requirements of the case, not hidden obligations. Regression: exactly one fenced Python block, one TestCase with 2–4 methods, permitted AST subset, actual 2–4 tests run, all pass on correct implementation, mutant detected, all required literal calls covered, expected values correct. Required call tuples are specified in the case task and rubric. Runtime check results cannot be replaced by review opinion.

ACG semantics: every provided rule, operation, path, before/after correct; supplied normative serialization interpretation correct; missing evidence stated; consequence framed as possible; concrete check not claimed executed. Presence of keywords alone is insufficient. Release semantics: exact old/new and units, supplied counts/statuses preserved, contradiction stated when present, synthetic provenance and integration/deployment limits explicit, no unsupported gains/users. Language/format/length/last sentence enforced for all applicable cases. Runtime and instruction success do not imply task success.

An independent reviewer receives masked output IDs, case input, references and rubric without arm labels/packages. It records instructions_success, task_success and supporting excerpts for every output, including failures. Root recomputes strict counts and checks evidence, preserving reviewer disagreements. Report descriptive totals/family and pairwise wins/ties/losses on completed triplets. Nine cases and one deterministic repetition do not support significance, adoption, causal model/runtime attribution or generalization. Preparation failures are published even if final gate never opens. Post-result protocol issues are limitations for future work, never used to revise this score.

author_brief.common: Instructions réutilisables en français, corps Markdown seul, 200 mots maximum par séparation sur espaces. Aucun YAML, bloc englobant, lien ou fichier externe, commande arbitraire, valeur ou identifiant recopié du cas de développement. Respecter les exigences de langue, longueur, format, sections et dernière phrase des futures tâches. Ne pas inventer de preuve.

families.acg: Pour chaque changement, citer règle, opération, chemin exacts, état précédent et suivant. Ne pas remplir un champ absent. Expliquer une conséquence possible pour le consommateur comme hypothèse. Pour toute convention de sérialisation, suivre la référence normative fournie ; sans référence, exprimer l'incertitude. Proposer une vérification concrète non exécutée. Ne pas inventer appel client, tests ou compatibilité.
families.regression: Contrat discounted_total(amount, discount) = round(amount * (1-discount), 2), amount >= 0, discount dans [0,1], sinon ValueError. Ne pas modifier calcul. Calculer les valeurs attendues. Couvrir une réduction non nulle et une frontière ou entrée invalide, plus les cas imposés. Un seul bloc Python, import unittest et from calcul import discounted_total, une classe unittest.TestCase avec 2 à 4 méthodes test_. Assertions directes sur constantes littérales et assertRaises uniquement, sans assignations, boucles, subTest, décorateurs, imports supplémentaires. Terminer par unittest.main() sans argument sous la garde __name__. Réussir sur l'implémentation correcte et détecter le mutant ignorant discount. Ne pas prétendre à une couverture exhaustive.
families.release: Lire diff et résultats fournis. Conserver exactement ancien/nouveau et unités, nombres et statuts des tests. Sections Changement, Résultats fournis, Vérifications restantes dans cet ordre. Préserver échecs, intégration non exécutée et déploiement non effectué. Nommer les contradictions sans choisir silencieusement une source. Identifier les données synthétiques. Ne pas déduire performance, utilisateurs ou déploiement du diff. Respecter langue, longueur et dernière phrase de la tâche.

cases.inputs: Rapport synthétique : reports/synthetic/acg/query-labels-diff.json. Ancien GET /catalog/items : le paramètre query labels est un tableau de chaînes, required=false, style=form, explode=true. Nouveau : même type et required=false, mais style=spaceDelimited, explode=false. Règle : QUERY_PARAMETER_SERIALIZATION_CHANGED. Selon OpenAPI 3.1.1, form avec explode=true répète les paires query; spaceDelimited avec explode=false place les éléments dans une valeur délimitée par des espaces. Source : OpenAPI Specification 3.1.1, 24 octobre 2024, sections 4.8.12.3-4, https://spec.openapis.org/oas/v3.1.1.html. Aucun inventaire client, trafic ou test n’est fourni.

Qualifie l’effet de possible et la vérification de non exécutée.
